تتطارحوا (form VI)
# تَتَطَارَحُوا (tataṭāraḥū) /ta.ta.tˤaː.ra.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَطَارَحَ (taṭāraḥa)
# تُتَطَارَحُوا (tutaṭāraḥū) /tu.ta.tˤaː.ra.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَطَارَحَ (taṭāraḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
